Titles.eng: Anne of Green Gables: Road to Green Gables
Titles.jpn: 赤毛のアン グリーンゲーブルズへの道

Summaries.eng: In this movie that summarizes the first six episodes of Anne of Green Gables, we follow the story of Anne, an orphan full of imagination. When she arrives at her new home, she learns that sometimes you have to be a sensible person, while her unique character changes, or at least attracts, the people around her.
